promptEs: En Fa mayor, ¿cómo se cifra el dominante secundario que resuelve en ii?
promptEn: In F major, how is the secondary dominant that resolves to ii labelled?
explanationEs: En Fa mayor, el dominante de ii es Re7 y se cifra V/ii. Resuelve en Solm (ii): su tercera es la sensible de Solm y sube un semitono.
explanationEn: In F major, the dominant of ii is D7 and it is labelled V/ii. It resolves to Gm (ii): its third is the leading tone of Gm and rises a semitone.
